method.source_figure: Figure 5, 'Measured free-beam neutron spectrum obtained by iterative adjustment for the FiR 1 epithermal neutron beam facility (14 cm aperture)', INEEL/EXT-01-00204 annual report (Nigg, Wemple, Seren, Seppala, Auterinen), report p.66
method.digitization: 400-dpi render; disk-template blob detection of the INEEL-adjustment marker series; pixel-to-log axes calibrated on the plot frame (x: 1e-3..1e8 eV, y: 1e3..1e9 n/cm2-s per unit lethargy); 31 marker centers extracted
method.curve_construction: piecewise log-log interpolation of the digitized markers; below 0.051 eV a room-temperature Maxwellian tail is added (foil set had suppressed low-energy sensitivity — boron-sphere method); region integrals anchored to the VTT LSL-M2 experimental values (Seppala 2002 Table 4): thermal 7.19e7, epithermal 1.07e9, fast 3.45e7 n/cm2-s
method.validation: epithermal-region integral of the digitized markers before anchoring: 9.38e8 vs published INEEL direct unfolding 9.32e8 (0.6%) and SAND-II 9.52e8

citations.authors: Nigg, D.W.; Wemple, C.A.; Seren, T.; Seppala, T.; Auterinen, I.
citations.title: Improved evaluation of the free-beam spectrum of the FiR 1 clinical epithermal-neutron beam facility for BNCT
citations.venue: INEEL BNCT Research Program Annual Report, INEEL/EXT-01-00204

notes: Research-grade figure digitization, not a facility-qualified spectrum. Thermal tail below the figure's left edge is model-completed and carries the published +/-21% experimental uncertainty; fast-region anchor factor 1.31 is disclosed above.
